Declare capabilities for a model process

Source: R/processes.R
setProcess.Rd

Register a convergence callback or a prescribed-input declaration for the current consumers or resource process. The declaration is stored in the model together with the identity of its current dynamics provider. Replacing that provider or changing the projection dispatch chain invalidates the declaration until support is explicitly adopted again. Changing parameters or consumer rate functions leaves the identity of the fish equations intact. Calling setProcess(params, process) with no capability arguments explicitly adopts the current provider for all retained capability families. A partial patch adopts only the families explicitly supplied: convergence/role, stationary/equation rates/tuning, reproduction level, transformations, or mortality diagnostics, prescribed inputs, temporal dependence or resource equations. Omitted families keep their previous provider bindings, including staleness. A replacement definition adopts all its supplied capabilities.

Usage

setProcess(
  params,
  process,
  definition,
  convergence_fun,
  role,
  stationary,
  equation_rates_fun,
  tuning,
  level_fun,
  transformations,
  mortality_fun,
  prescribed_mask_fun,
  autonomous,
  rate_fun
)

getProcess(params, process)

Arguments

params

A MizerParams object.

process

"consumers", "resource" or "reproduction". The latter has no state role or convergence callback.

definition

A named list of assessment and tuning capabilities.

convergence_fun

Name of an assessment callback, optionally qualified as package::exported_function, or NULL.

role

Either "dynamic" or "prescribed" for a state process.

stationary

Explicit TRUE/FALSE stationary-tuning declaration.

equation_rates_fun

Callback exposing effective equation quantities.

tuning

Named strategies and their default, or NULL to remove support.

level_fun

Law-specific reproduction-level callback, or NULL.

transformations

Named operation declarations for structural and scale changes. Each declares action = 'none' or a named transform_fun with action = 'update', explicit paths and optional settings. Supply this argument or a new definition to adopt support for a changed provider; an assessment-only update retains the previous transformation binding.

mortality_fun

Named consumer mortality-breakdown callback, or NULL to remove diagnostic support. It is bound independently of other families.

prescribed_mask_fun

Named structural mask callback. It receives params and optional owner/process and returns logical values with the exact state dimensions and names; TRUE marks prescribed inputs. It is not called with time or state values. Use role = 'dynamic' for a partial mask.

autonomous

TRUE for equations without explicit time dependence, FALSE for forced equations, or NULL for undeclared support. This is independent of stationary tuning. Declare reproduction autonomy on consumers, whose temporal binding includes the complete effective rate pipeline.

rate_fun

Named exact resource equation callback returning dn_pp/dt, with the state dimensions and names. Its context includes params, n, n_pp, n_other, rates and t. Only the resource process accepts this capability.

Value

setProcess() returns the updated model. getProcess() returns the callback, role, reusable definition and recorded provider binding. With no process argument, getProcess() returns all stored processes.

Details

A convergence callback returns a data frame with the columns measure, value, tolerance and units. It supplies measurements, not verdicts; getSteadyAssessment() compares each absolute value with its tolerance. Callback arguments include the model, state, complete rate list, derivative, time and process name; accept ... for arguments not needed by the callback.

A new definition replaces the previous callback and role before explicit arguments are applied. Without definition, omitted arguments are retained. The default role is "dynamic". A "prescribed" role declares the whole state block as an input rather than a dynamic variable. A dynamic owner may declare a partial prescribed_mask_fun. Supplying convergence_fun = NULL removes its callback. State and equations are not changed by this registration.

See also

setComponent(), getSteadyAssessment()

Other extension tools: NOther(), coerceToExtensionClass(), initialNOther<-(), mizerReproductionDefinition(), other_mort(), recordExtension(), setComponent(), setRateFunction()
